#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MAXN = 262144;

int L, nn, kk, Mod, len;
int bit[20], fac[MAXN], inv[MAXN], cnt[MAXN], g[20][MAXN], f[20][MAXN];
ll h[20], p[20];

inline int pwr(int x, int y) {
    int z = 1;
    while (y) {
        if (y & 1) z = (ll)z * x % Mod;
        x = (ll)x * x % Mod;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return z;
}

inline void add_mod(int &x, int y) {
    x += y;
    if (x >= Mod) x -= Mod;
}

inline void sub_mod(int &x, int y) {
    x -= y;
    if (x < 0) x += Mod;
}

void fwt(int *a, int m) {
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)
                add_mod(a[j + k + i], a[j + k]);
}

void ifwt(int *a, int m) {
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)
                sub_mod(a[j + k + i], a[j + k]);
}

void poly_ln() {
    p[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nn; i++) {
        p[i] = h[i] * i;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
            p[i] -= p[j] * h[i - j] % Mod * j;
        p[i] = p[i] % Mod * inv[i] % Mod;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) h[i] = (p[i] + Mod) % Mod;
}

void poly_exp() {
    p[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nn; i++) {
        p[i] = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
            p[i] += h[j] * p[i - j] % Mod * j;
        p[i] = p[i] % Mod * inv[i] % Mod;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) h[i] = p[i];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &L, &kk, &Mod);
    int all = pwr(kk, L);

    if (L & 1) {
        printf("%d\n", all);
        return 0;
    }

    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) fac[i] = (ll)fac[i - 1] * i % Mod;

    inv[L] = pwr(fac[L], Mod - 2);
    for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) inv[i] = (ll)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mod;

    for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) cnt[s] = cnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i <= 18; i++)
        if ((L >> i) & 1) bit[++nn] = 1 << i;

    len = 1 << nn;

    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        int s = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= nn; j++)
            if ((i >> (j - 1)) & 1) s += bit[j];
        g[cnt[i]][i] = inv[s];
    }

    for (int i = 2; i <= nn; i++)
        inv[i] = (ll)(Mod - Mod / i) * inv[Mod % i] % Mod;

    for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) fwt(g[i], len);

    for (int s = 0; s < len; s++) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) h[i] = g[i][s];
        poly_ln();
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) h[i] = h[i] * kk;
        poly_exp();
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) f[i][s] = h[i];
    }

    ifwt(f[nn], len);

    int ans = (ll)f[nn][len - 1] * fac[L] % Mod;
    ans = (all - ans + Mod) % Mod;

    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

template <typename T>

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)

template <typename T>
void ifwht(T *a, int n) {

    FOR(i, 1, m) {
        q[i] = 0;
        FOR(j, 1, i)
            q[i] += r[j] * q[i - j] % MOD * j;
        q[i] = q[i] % MOD * invv[i] % MOD;
    }
    FOR(i, 0, m) r[i] = q[i];
}
